memory.title: Negative search evidence is coverage-scoped, not repository-global
memory.durable_rule: A zero-result code, branch, file-library, chat-history, or commit search may disqualify candidates inside the explicitly observed search scope, but it cannot classify M-004, M-005, or M-006 as unlocated repository-wide until branch inventory, reachable history, query semantics, pagination, indexing status, and privacy-eligible source classes are independently bounded.
memory.operational_consequence: Preserve unresolved status when any coverage dimension is unknown. Record the exact search surface, query, result count, pagination state, ref set, index status, and source class before using negative evidence.
memory.promotion_rule: The terminal claim unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage requires affirmative evidence for every required coverage dimension; absence of evidence is not evidence of exhaustive absence.

claims.claim: The canonical queue explicitly requires exhaustive branch inventory or equivalent history traversal before M-004, M-005, or M-006 can be classified as unlocated.
The repository default branch is main and the connected principal has administrative repository access.
A connector branch search with an empty query returned zero results, while repository metadata still identified main as the default branch.
claims.source: GitHub search_branches and get_repo calls retrieved 2026-07-14T22:23Z

claims.claim: Therefore a zero-result connector search can reflect search-interface semantics or indexing limits rather than true repository absence.
claims.falsification_route: Demonstrate documented complete branch enumeration from the same connector call, including main, with pagination and coverage guarantees.

claims.claim: M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved reported identifiers.
claims.supersedes: Any prose implying they are verified artifacts or conclusively absent.

claims.claim: Future exhaustive traversal may locate immutable assignments or justify unlocated_after_exhaustive_coverage.

contradiction_resolution.apparent_contradiction: A search returned zero results while a known default branch exists.
contradiction_resolution.resolution: The search result is evidence about that invocation, not a complete branch inventory. Repository metadata and search output describe different coverage surfaces and must not be conflated.
